Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to subtract two 2D matrices of integers. 
Input Description:
The program should accept:
An integer r representing the number of rows in the matrices.
An integer c representing the number of columns in the matrices.
r × c integers representing the elements of the first matrix.
r × c integers representing the elements of the second matrix. 
Output Description:
The program should print the resulting difference matrix, where each element is the result of subtracting the corresponding elements of the second matrix from the first matrix.
Each row of the resulting matrix should be printed on a new line. 
Sample Input:
2 2
5 6
7 8
1 2
3 4 
Sample Output:
4 4
4 4
